verdict.rationale: Automation versioning is a fair question for Shopify POS, since the evidence mentions Shopify Flow-powered low-stock notifications and Sidekick-created stock transfers. However, nothing in the pack documents versioning, review, change history or rollback of those automations. Flow notifications and POS UI extensions scaffolded with Shopify CLI are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
